title: Time slips away
odia: ମାରି ମାରି ଗଲା କାଳକ ଆଉ ରହିଗଲା ଫାଳକ
literal_meaning: Whiling it away, time has gone; a half remains.
explanation: Time has passed while one was merely getting through it. The remaining half is a rhyming image, not a measured lifespan.
meaning_odia: ଏମିତି ଦିନ କାଟୁକାଟୁ ବହୁତ ସମୟ ଚାଲିଗଲାଣି, ଆଉ ଯାହା ବାକି ତାହାର କଥା ମନେ ପଡ଼ୁଛି। ଗଡ଼ିଯାଇଥିବା ସମୟକୁ ପଛକୁ ଚାହିଁ ଦେଖିବାର ଭାବ ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। ‘ଫାଳକ’ ଛନ୍ଦର ଏକ ଚିତ୍ର; ଜୀବନର ଠିକ୍ ଅଧା ରହିଛି ବୋଲି ମାପ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: After postponing a task repeatedly, someone notices how much of the available time has passed. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary places this under whiling away time. It does not establish the speaker’s age.

odia_summary: ଏମିତି ସମୟ କାଟୁକାଟୁ ବେଳ ଚାଲିଗଲାଣି; ଯାହା ବାକି ଅଛି ତାହାର କଥା ମନେ ପଡ଼ୁଛି।
english_summary: Time slips by while someone is merely getting through it; the remaining half is not a measured lifespan.
